IFS.RD_DATE_ERR_FLAG /* 요청일오류 */ , IFS.PO_DATE_ERR_FLAG /* 발주일오류 */ , IFS.BUYER_ITEM_ERR_FLAG /* 품목코드미등록 */ , IFS.UNIT_PRICE_ERR_FLAG /* 판매단가 불일치 */ , IFS.CREATE_DATE /* 생성일자 */ , IFS.CREATE_TIME /* 생성시간 */ , IFS.LOAD_DATE /* 작업일자 */ , IFS.LOAD_TIME /* 작업시간 */ , IFS.PR_NO_B , IFS.PR_SEQ_B , IFS.PO_NO , IFS.PO_SEQ , IFS.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , IFS.PLANT , IFS.CANCEL_DATE , IFS.CANCEL_RSON , IFS.CANCEL_ID , IFS.GW_NO , IFS.GW_STATUS FROM ( SELECT /*+ USE_NL(A K) INDEX(B ICOMPRDT_07) INDEX(C ICOMPODT_09) INDEX(D ICOMCQDT_PK) INDEX(E ICOMCOD2_PK) INDEX(F ICOMCMPY_PK) INDEX(G ICOMCMPY_PK) INDEX(I ICOMBYIT_PK) INDEX(J ICOMCMPY_PK) INDEX(AA SYS_C0052550) INDEX(BB KEP_CURRENCY_DT_PK) */ TRIM(A.ERROR_MSG) AS ERROR_MSG , J.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NAME , AA.IF_FLAG AS IF_FLAG_PROGRESS , CASE WHEN A.GW_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '8' /* 상신중 */ WHEN AA.IF_FLAG = 'C' THEN '1' /* 작업대기 */ WHEN AA.IF_FLAG <> 'C' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' THEN '0' /* 정상 */ WHEN AA.IF_FLAG IS NULL AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' THEN '0' /* 정상 */ WHEN AA.IF_FLAG <> 'C' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'E' THEN '2' /* 오류건 */ WHEN AA.IF_FLAG IS NULL AND A.IF_FLAG = 'E' THEN '2' /* 오류건 */ WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'D' THEN '7' /* 삭제건 */ END IF_PROGRESS_PODT , CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'C' THEN '3' WHEN A.STATUS = 'R' THEN '4' WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN '5' END AS IF_STATUS /* IF상태 */ , CASE WHEN B.STATUS = 'C' THEN '3' WHEN B.STATUS = 'R' THEN '4' WHEN B.STATUS = 'D' THEN '5' ELSE '6' END AS PR_STATUS /* PR상태 */ , CASE WHEN C.STATUS = 'C' THEN '3' WHEN C.STATUS = 'R' THEN '4' WHEN C.STATUS = 'D' THEN '5' ELSE '6' END AS PO_STATUS /* PO상태 */ , A.STATUS AS IF_EXCEL , B.STATUS AS PR_EXCEL , C.STATUS AS PO_EXCEL , F.COM_NAME_LOC AS COM_NAME_IF , G.COM_NAME_LOC AS COM_NAME_PO , A.LEGACY_PR_NO AS LEGACY_PR_NO , CASE WHEN A.EXP_CUR = 'USD' THEN BB.EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE ELSE D.UNIT_PRICE END AS UNIT_PRICE_PAN , A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE_IF , C.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE_PO , D.LIST_PRICE AS PRCHS , (D.LIST_PRICE * A.ITEM_QTY) AS PRCHS_AMT , CASE WHEN A.EXP_CUR = 'USD' THEN (BB.EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE * A.ITEM_QTY) ELSE (D.UNIT_PRICE * A.ITEM_QTY) END AS UNIT_PRICE_AMT , CASE WHEN A.EXP_CUR = 'USD' THEN ((BB.EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE - D.LIST_PRICE ) * A.ITEM_QTY ) ELSE ((D.UNIT_PRICE - D.LIST_PRICE ) * A.ITEM_QTY ) END AS PRF_AMN , CASE WHEN A.EXP_CUR = 'USD' THEN ROUND(((BB.EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE - D.LIST_PRICE ) / BB.EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE) * 100, 2) ELSE ROUND(((D.UNIT_PRICE - D.LIST_PRICE ) / D.UNIT_PRICE ) * 100, 2) END AS MARGIN_RETE , BD.EXP_CUR_PRICE AS BUYER_EXP_CUR_PRICE , ROUND((BD.EXP_CUR_PRICE * A.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE)) AS BUYER_PRICE_PAN , (BD.EXP_CUR_PRICE * A.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE) AS BUYER_PRF_AMN , A.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE AS EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE_PODT , A.EXP_FOR_ITEM_AMT AS EXP_FOR_ITEM_AMT , BB.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE AS EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE_CUR , (BB.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE * A.ITEM_QTY) AS EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE_AMT , A.EXP_CUR AS EXP_CUR , A.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY_IF , C.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY_PO , A.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE_IF , C.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE_PO , A.PURCHASER_USER_ID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , A.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , H.TEXT2 AS IVDT_TYPE , CASE WHEN A.DOC_TYPE = 'N' THEN '일반' WHEN A.DOC_TYPE = 'S' THEN '선입고' ELSE '' END AS PO_TYPE , A.REQ_USER_INFO AS REQ_USER_INFO , A.REMARK2 AS REMARK2 , A.REF_IF_NO AS REF_IF_NO , I.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION , I.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , A.REMARK AS REMARK , A.HD_REMARK , A.BUYER AS BUYER , A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ORG_BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , A.AGENT AS AGENT , A.PURCHASER_USER_DEPT AS PURCHASER_USER_DEPT , J.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL AS COMORG_LEVEL , A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ , A.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE , A.IF_FLAG AS IF_FLAG , C.PO_NO AS PO_NO , C.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ , C.PR_NO AS PR_NO , C.PR_SEQ AS PR_SEQ , F.COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME , C.ITEM_AMT AS ITEM_AMT , C.AGENT_ITEM_AMT AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT , CASE WHEN C.STATUS = 'C' THEN '신규' WHEN C.STATUS = 'R' THEN '수정' WHEN C.STATUS = 'D' THEN '삭제' ELSE '' END AS PO_STATUS2 /* PO상태 */ , CASE WHEN C.STATUS = 'C' THEN '신규' WHEN C.STATUS = 'R' THEN '수정' WHEN C.STATUS = 'D' THEN '삭제' ELSE '' END AS PR_STATUS2 /* PR상태 */ , CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' AND ERROR_MSG LIKE '%발주자 미등록%' THEN 'X' ELSE '' END AS PURCHASER_USER_ID_ERR_FLAG , A.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE /* 발주일 */ , CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' AND ERROR_MSG LIKE '%발주일 오류%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PO_DATE_ERR_FLAG , CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' AND ERROR_MSG LIKE '%요구일 오류%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS RD_DATE_ERR_FLAG , A.DESCRIPTION AS IF_DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION AS IF_SPECIFICATION , E.TEXT2 AS ADDRESS /* 도착지주소 */ , CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' AND A.ERROR_MSG LIKE '%품목코드 미등록%' AND TRIM(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IF_PODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND IF_FLAG != 'D') = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BUYER_ITEM_ERR_FLAG , CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' AND A.ERROR_MSG LIKE '%판매단가 불일치%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS UNIT_PRICE_ERR_FLAG , CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' AND ERROR_MSG LIKE '%도착지코드 미등록%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_ERR_FLAG , A.CREATE_DATE , A.CREATE_TIME , A.LOAD_DATE , A.LOAD_TIME , B.PR_NO AS PR_NO_B , B.PR_SEQ AS PR_SEQ_B , A.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRSAMS0123' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND TEXT4 = 'OVERSEA' AND CODE = A.PLANT) AS PLANT , A.CANCEL_DATE , A.CANCEL_RSON , A.CANCEL_ID , A.GW_NO , A.GW_STATUS FROM IF_PODT A /* 인터페이스 주문상세내역 */ LEFT OUTER JOIN KEP_CURRENCY_DT BB /* 외화단가정보 */ ON( BB.EXP_CODE IN ((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'CRCY' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) ) AND BB.BUYER = ( SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER ) AND BB.CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND BB.CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ AND BB.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO )
LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPRDT B /* 구매요청 제품정보 */ ON (B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.LEGACY_PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND NVL(B.REF_PR_NO, ' ') = NVL(DECODE(B.BUYER, 'KRDAEW0016', B.REF_PR_NO, 'KRDONG0109', B.REF_PR_NO, NVL(A.LEGACY_PR_NO, ' ')), ' ') ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPODT C /* 발주 제품정보 */ ON (C.BUYER = A.BUYER AND C.LEGACY_PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND C.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND NVL(C.REF_PR_NO, ' ') = NVL(DECODE(C.BUYER, 'KRDAEW0016', C.REF_PR_NO, 'KRDONG0109', C.REF_PR_NO, NVL(A.LEGACY_PR_NO, ' ')), ' ') ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCQDT D /* 구매사별 계약서 가격정보 */ ON (D.BUYER = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND D.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND D.CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND D.CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ AND D.AGENT = A.AGENT ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 E /* 회사별 코드관리 */ ON (E.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND E.TYPE = 'C012' AND E.CODE = A.DELY_TO_LOCATION ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY F /* 회원사정보 */ ON (F.COM_CODE = A.AGENT) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY G /* 회원사정보 */ ON (G.COM_CODE = B.AGENT) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD1 H /* 마스터 코드관리 */ ON (H.TYPE = 'M034' AND H.CODE = D.PROCESS_TYPE AND H.FLAG = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBYIT I /* 구매사카탈로그 상품정보 */ ON (I.BUYER = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND I.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY J /* 회원사정보 */ ON (J.COM_CODE = A.BUYER) LEFT OUTER JOIN KEP_CURRENCY_HD BD /* 외화단가정보 */ ON( BD.EXP_CODE = ((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'CRCY' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) ) ) INNER JOIN IF_PROGRESS AA /* 오류 현황 메인 */ ON (AA.BUYER = A.BUYER AND AA.LEGACY_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND AA.GUBUN = 'PO' AND AA.IF_FLAG NOT IN ('Y','D') ) WHERE 1=1 /*AND A.IF_FLAG <> 'D'*/
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_DEPT = #{st_user_dept} )
AND A.ERROR_MSG LIKE '%'||#{st_err_text}||'%'
AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_legacy_po_no} || '%'
AND A.LEGACY_PR_NO LIKE #{st_legacy_pr_no} || '%'
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND A.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
/*20230823 삭제만 조회 추가 -> select list로 변경*/
AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('E','N')
AND A.IF_FLAG = 'E'
AND A.IF_FLAG = 'D'
/* AND A.IF_FLAG = 'E'
AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('E','N') */
ORDER BY A.BUYER , A.LEGACY_PO_NO , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) IFS
